gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.re.zh: 匹配区：ghost 标记（左键标记 / 空手左键配置 / Shift+左键清除）
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.re.en: Markers: ghost markers (left-click to mark / empty-hand left-click to configure / Shift+left-click to clear)

gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.re.zh: 缓存区：真实存储，装不下的暂存于此并继续尝试入网
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.re.en: Cache: real storage; overflow is held here and retried into the network

gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.bl.zh: 未阻塞（正常回流进网络）
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.bl.en: Not blocked (returned to the network normally)

gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.ma.zh: 按标签匹配（一整类资源）
要求数据组件（NBT）完全一致才命中
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.ma.en: Require data components (NBT) to match exactly

gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.bl.zh: 阻塞后仍可收集 / 取出，只是不再回流进 RS 网络
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.bl.en: Blocked resources can still be collected/extracted, just no longer returned to the RS network

gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.ma.zh: 打开后多选示例物自带的标签；命中物需同时带上全部选中标签
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.ma.en: Turn on to multi-select tags the sample carries; a match must carry all of them

gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.in.zh: 逐面开关物流输入（漏斗 / 管道）
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.in.en: Toggle which faces accept logistics input (hoppers/pipes)

gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.in.zh: 该面允许漏斗 / 管道塞入
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.in.en: This face accepts items/fluids from hoppers/pipes

gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.in.zh: 该面不接收输入（仍可抽走）
gui.rs_create_compat.collection_cache.in.en: This face refuses input (extraction is still allowed)

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 把原料推给该面的相邻机器
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Push inputs to the machine on this face

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 从该面收回过渡件并回写网络
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Collect transitional items here and return them to the network

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 面输出：按左侧六个面的配置工作
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Face output: works by the six face settings on the left

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 总线输出：忽略逐面配置，由相连的输出总线代劳
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Bus output: per-face settings are ignored; a connected exporter bus does the work
